_note: Document provenance (document-provenance REQ-DPV-001, first written by woo-requests-gather-documents-from-sources design D-4). A document collected onto a case, for any case type, records where it was found. A copied file carries `provenance` on its own informatieobject. A document linked from another case carries it on THIS case's zaakinformatieobject join instead, because the record also belongs to the other case and must not be rewritten by a search on this one. Read through CaseDocumentProvenance, never field by field. A fragment rather than an edit to 70-document-zaakdossier.json, per ADR-037.

provenance.title: Where it was found
provenance.description: Where this document was found when it was collected onto a case: the source and system, the custodian whose files held it, its location, the search terms, when the search ran and who ran it. Written once, when the document is collected.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source it came from: files, cases or microsoft365.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where it sat in that source: a folder path, a site and folder, a mailbox, or the other case.

terms.title: Search terms
terms.description: The terms the search ran with.

searchedBy.title: Searched by
searchedBy.description: The user who ran the search and added the document.

custodian.title: Custodian
custodian.description: The person or function whose files this document came from.

mail.title: Mail headers
mail.description: The header fields of a collected e-mail, read when it is collected: sender, recipients, cc, date and message id, addresses lower-cased. A mail whose headers cannot be read carries only unreadable: true. Absent on a document that is no mail.

date.title: Sent
date.description: When the mail was sent, from its Date header.

messageId.title: Message id
messageId.description: The Message-ID header, without angle brackets.

unreadable.title: Headers unreadable
unreadable.description: True when the mail's headers could not be read; a report counts it under unreadable.
